title: Why leopards take dinner up a tree
caption:
A tree is a leopard's fridge with a lock on it.

In the same study, at least 21% of kills were stolen, mostly by spotted hyenas, and the risk was highest for big kills left on the ground.

Source: Balme, Miller, Pitman & Hunter 2017, Journal of Animal Ecology. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
